native_cpu_and_lexical_evidence.scope: This normalizer does not replace the independent native-library/CPU/Tantivy record extraction. Its five successful build steps are not a license, CPU portability or lexical adoption conclusion.

interpretation.counts: Normal engine 27, child 2, Python 38, and three distinct private guard tests repeated twice are separate test scopes. SQL 20/22/20/26 and pipes 7/8 include repeated common cases; no count measures completed capabilities.
interpretation.captured_children: Named dirty-rebuild, negative-input and public-lifecycle harness passes are bound to this source. Their successful captured JSON is not copied from local runs or inferred from an absent CI artifact.
interpretation.source_diagnostics: Seven bounded superuser-only source groups include inside-SPI cancellation and same-backend retry. This is not production SELECT/RLS authorization or source synchronization.
interpretation.disk: The 32 MiB vector/keyword config-save fault and 384 MiB full-text config-save fault are separate from the no-filler 384 MiB control. The 128 MiB case verifies refusal without writes, not reopen/recovery. Historical 128 MiB SIGBUS failures remain valid evidence.
interpretation.oom: Kernel cgroup/victim records are cross-checked with supplied inner observations. Direct-worker collateral loss and helper containment are experimental outcomes under selected oom_score_adj; not production memory isolation.
interpretation.durability: Flushed fixtures and controller-policy dirty refusal do not establish unflushed WAL replay, power-loss durability, a production generation switch or PostgreSQL/Edge atomicity.

normalization.log_lines: One-based lines in the complete hashed job log.
normalization.selection: Named Cargo harness/test records and semantic artifact profiles; no global JSON indices or fixed line ranges.
normalization.removed: Duplicate disk stderr/stdout and observations; incidental mount device/inode. One random owned PostgreSQL data-directory path replaced by a placeholder. Exact kernel attribution identities retained.

reproduction.positive_faults: Use only the exact dedicated disposable containers, guarded mounts and resource limits in the tested workflow.
